X-TEND™ Beach Club with electric Transforma sun lounger
Full Simrad NSO evo3S Premium navigation package
CMC fin stabilisers, effective underway and at anchor
Hardtop with retractable central canopy and tilting vane system

description:
Delivered in early 2023 and kept by a single owner since new, this Sunseeker 88 Yacht is a low-hours, highly specified example of Sunseeker's flagship flybridge, now offered for sale in Phuket, Thailand.

Four en-suite cabins welcome eight guests, with a full-beam master stateroom amidships and a VIP cabin forward, both with key-locked doors and concealed safes. Two further guest cabins convert between twin and double. The crew area has two cabins, a bathroom, a mess and direct engine room access.

At the stern, the acclaimed X-TEND Beach Club unfolds an electric sun lounger facing the sea, completed by SeaBob lockers and an overhead rain shower. The teak-laid flybridge seats twelve, with a full wet bar, BBQ and an Opacmare davit for a jet ski.

Twin MTU 12V 2000 M96X engines deliver 3,600 HP for a top speed of 28 knots and a 21-knot cruise, with a range of 1,300 nautical miles. Contact Yacht Research for the full specification, survey history and viewing arrangements.
